title: ChatPattern: Layout Pattern Customization via Natural Language
problem: Existing layout pattern generation techniques focus on fixed-size patterns, while practical free-size pattern generation receives limited attention. This limits designers' ability to flexibly customize layout patterns according to diverse requirements specified in natural language.
motivation: Enabling natural language-driven flexible pattern customization would allow designers to intuitively specify complex design constraints and modifications for layout synthesis.
method: ChatPattern uses two connected pieces: a language model (an AI trained on text) that understands what a designer wants, and a layout pattern generator (a tool that creates visual arrangements of elements). The language model reads the designer's request in plain English and controls the layout tool to do what's needed. The layout tool can generate patterns that fit any size, modify existing patterns, and extend them without using excessive memory, all coordinated by the language model.
key_novelty: It combines natural language understanding (interpreting what a designer says) with a highly controllable pattern generator that can create and modify layouts of any size.
contributions: A novel LLM-powered framework enabling flexible layout pattern customization via natural language specifications
An expert LLM agent that interprets natural language requirements and operates design tools autonomously
A controllable generator supporting conditional generation, pattern modification, and memory-friendly pattern extension
Demonstration of high-quality large-scale pattern synthesis capability

metrics.other: high-quality large-scale pattern synthesis (specific quantitative metrics not provided)

limitations: Specific performance comparisons with existing pattern generation approaches and quantitative evaluation metrics are not discussed.
primary_theme: LLM-based layout pattern generation via natural language
